invariants.rationale: The rollback instant time should represent a valid instant and should not be null at the entry.
A commit instant is needed to identify what is being rolled back; it should not be null.
It is likely that a non-empty instant time string is required for rollback operations.
deleteInstants is a boolean, so its only possible values are true or false.
skipLocking is a boolean and must be deterministically true or false at entry.
